_comment: TRUST ROOT for the company-hd CLI. Edit mount.server / mount.share to point at YOUR company NAS. Keep mode read-only until you have a write rollout.

_levels.L0: READ — ls, tree, cat, stat, find, map. No mutation. ENABLED.
_levels.L1: CREATE-NEW — author a brand-new file into an allowed folder; never overwrites. DISABLED.
_levels.L2: VERSION-SAVE — write a new versioned copy alongside; original untouched. DISABLED.
_levels.L3: OWN-MODIFY — freely modify a file the agent itself created. DISABLED.
_levels.NEVER: Overwrite or delete another author's file. Never auto.

audit._note: Append-only JSONL, stored OFF the audited disk.

_defaultTier_note: Fail-safe: unclassified folders are Tier 1 (read-only) until explicitly tiered.
